name: [VOICE CHAT] Bisley, England Beta
desc:
Bisley, England is a highly detailed UK:RP experience set in the heart of Gloucestershire. Explore a true-to-life 1:1 scale map of the historic village of Bisley, complete with realistic British architecture, countryside roads, and local landmarks.

🚗 Drive Realistic Vehicles – Choose from a wide range of accurately modelled vehicles, all with authentic handling and features.

🏡 Live the British Life – Go to work, own a house and immerse yourself in the daily life of a Bisley resident.

📍 Authentic Environment – From narrow lanes to classic stone buildings, every inch of Bisley has been carefully recreated for realism.

☁️ Weather - Enjoy classical, British weather from clear blue skies to sudden downpours.
